first.rationale: Onboarding completion and activation are both declining. Prior evidence indicates shorter onboarding improved completion and time-to-value, while signup simplification durably improved SMB activation. Verify the original onboarding and activation-messaging records before committing, but simplify onboarding is the current leading action because it directly addresses both deteriorating measures without the known retention cost of promotional pricing.

final.rationale: Run a standard experiment simplifying onboarding. It directly addresses the 4% completion decline and has verified evidence of materially higher completion (+13%), faster time-to-value (-2.1 days), and improved 30-day retention (+3%), supporting sustainable qualified revenue. This also aligns with prior durable SMB activation gains from simplification. Activation messaging is a credible alternative with a verified +6% activation lift, but simplification more directly addresses both current funnel deterioration and retention. Do not use promotional pricing despite competitive pressure because prior evidence shows a material retention tradeoff.
